scope: Independent exact symbolic algebra for frozen T03 N=1 theory; no approximate-zero tests, PDE evolution, fitting or scans.

checks.name: 01_branch_algebra
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: K>0 and Gamma>0 imply PQ<0, ell<0 and Gamma!=1 by these exact identities.

checks.name: 02_lambda_series
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Independent logarithm Taylor series through h^5 before dividing by h.

checks.name: 03_epsilon_exact_log_identity
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: The rational squared identity yields the real logarithm identity on the positive regular branch.

checks.name: 04_epsilon_series
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Independent Taylor series of the centered F phase correction.

checks.name: 05_exact_physical_reconstruction
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Direct tau logarithmic x derivatives with E_x=K E, at the F midpoint.

checks.name: 06_Bu_direct_shift_jets
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Expand F and both G sigmoid jets at their three actual centered arguments.

checks.name: 07_Bv_direct_shift_jets
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Expand the exact v formula directly, including u(y+h) and u(y-h), to numerator order h^3.

checks.name: 08_full_u_tangents
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Differentiate the rational continuous field directly, including the E=e^z chain rule.

checks.name: 09_full_v_tangents
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Differentiate all amplitude, ell, Gamma and phase dependencies of v0 directly.

checks.name: 10_exact_even_parity
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: h reversal exchanges the two G arguments; centered H remains even by the exact epsilon identity.

checks.name: 11_logistic_Laurent_coefficients
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Laurent coefficients are evaluated by exact series and symbolic limits, not complex sampling.

checks.name: 12_irremovable_pole_coefficients
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Gamma!=1 makes f regular at an s pole and s regular at an f pole.

checks.name: 13_tangent_pole_order_and_rank_identity
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Cleared u/v tangents are polynomials in E, so pole orders are at most 2/3. With delta_q=-delta_p, delta_g=ell delta_p.

checks.name: 14_finite_h_collision_identities
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: On the regular branch all denominators and P+d are nonzero; every possible pole-family collision forces K=0.

checks.name: 15_finite_and_continuous_x_residues
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Symbolic x-residues at distinct finite-h pole families and their continuous counterparts.

checks.name: 16_frozen_rational_point
checks.criterion: Every exact symbolic residual is identically zero.
checks.detail: Evaluate only the single rational spectral point frozen in THEORY.md §9.

proof_limits: The regular real branch and analytic identity theorem are mathematical hypotheses/proofs, not inferred from CAS outputs.
Polynomial denominator clearing proves pole-order bounds; parameter factors affine in complex x do not add poles.
These checks verify formulas; they do not replace the functional analytic local-distance proof or certify a decimal integral.
The static family obstruction is not a common-initial-data evolution-error lower bound.
